summary.en: The baseline thickens into the request pill around its own text, the action chip takes the accent and is pressed, then the pill grows into the response card; or the same card re-read as its schema.
summary.zh: 基线向上加厚成包住自身文字的请求胶囊，动作按钮接过强调色被按下，胶囊再长成响应卡片；或者把同一张卡片重读成数据结构。

fits: A request and its response; any input that becomes a result in the same object.
notFor: Responses longer than six lines; two objects side by side.

intent.en: A request visibly becomes its response in the same object, so cause and result read as one gesture.
intent.zh: 请求在同一个对象里看得见地变成响应，因和果读起来是一个动作。

content.en: The line (≤ 30 chars) and swap, an action word (≤ 8 chars / 3 字), the product's call (status, reason, ms) and 2–6 body fields; schema form: the type's name and the word for 'schema'.
content.zh: 那行代码（≤ 30 字符）与替换，一个动作词（≤ 8 字符 / 3 字），产品的调用（状态码、原因、毫秒）和 2–6 个响应字段；结构形式：类型名和“结构”一词。

fits.zh: 请求与响应；任何在同一对象里变成结果的输入。

notFor.zh: 超过六行的响应；并排的两个对象。

en: Never show the pill's text and the card's body at once; content out first, then the shape.
zh: 胶囊里的字和卡片正文不能同时出现；先出内容，再变形状。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
